title: KuaiLab verified judge walkthrough

autonomous_campaign.recovery_summary: An invalidated ensemble run was discarded, its runner contract was corrected, and the retained champion was left unchanged.

case_study.decision: Rejected: it improved its matched base, but weakened the frozen champion.

criteria.name: Technical execution
criteria.proof: A complete six-stage loop, sealed evaluator, recovery route, budgets, and per-run telemetry.

criteria.name: Innovation & insight
criteria.proof: Experiment-tree search combines targeted refinement, method memory, and KuaiRand-specific slate reasoning.

criteria.name: Impact & relevance
criteria.proof: The system turns repeated recommender research into an inspectable autonomous workflow.

criteria.name: Feasibility & practicality
criteria.proof: Local-first, CPU-capable execution with deterministic smoke mode and bounded resource use.

criteria.name: Presentation & communication
criteria.proof: A live control room connects every score and deployment decision to persisted evidence.

limitations: The 0.612858 score is public validation evidence, not a hidden-test result.
The full champion is a research ensemble; distillation into a smaller deployable model remains future work.
Some label-free slate corrections assume the full candidate slate is available at inference.
